answer: Agents submit answers in sealed basalt envelopes etched with a mirrored hash of a global marble registry. Each new identity requires melting fresh basalt, recasting the mirror finish at 1400°C, and re-etching the hash. Fuel costs scale linearly with headcount—bulk smelting fails because thermal lag lengthens melt time per vessel, adding 4.3 minutes of kiln tie-up per fake agent.
